name: claude-code-config
description: Personal repository for managing Claude Code settings, plugins, and development customizations.

plugins.name: danishi
plugins.description: This is a danishi's base tool set.

plugins.name: pdf-editor
plugins.description: PDF page manipulation toolkit for deleting, reordering, inserting, rotating, splitting, and merging PDF pages and files.

plugins.name: nanobanana
plugins.description: Generate and edit images using Google Gemini (Nano Banana Pro / Nano Banana 2). Auto-selects model by complexity. Supports text-to-image, image editing, aspect ratios, 1K/2K/4K output, and batch generation.

plugins.name: lyria
plugins.description: Generate music files using Google Gemini Lyria 3. Auto-selects the model by request/purpose: Lyria 3 Pro for full-length structured songs with lyrics, Lyria 3 Clip for 30s clips, loops, and jingles. Supports genre/mood/instrument prompting, song-structure tags, and MP3/WAV output.

plugins.name: gemini-tts
plugins.description: Generate read-aloud audio (text-to-speech) using Google Gemini TTS (gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview). Auto-detects single-speaker narration vs 2-person multi-speaker dialogue from the input. Supports 30 prebuilt voices, natural-language style control and audio tags, text or file input, and WAV output.

plugins.name: veo
plugins.description: Generate videos using Google Gemini Veo 3.1. Defaults to the cost-effective Veo 3.1 Lite model; the premium (Veo 3.1) and Fast models are opt-in via --pro/--fast. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video (first/last frame), 16:9 / 9:16, 720p/1080p (4k on Pro), 4-8s clips, and 1-4 videos per request.

plugins.name: video-composer
plugins.description: Produce rich, finished video content with React Remotion by orchestrating the repository's media skills (nanobanana images, veo video, lyria BGM, gemini-tts narration) on a data-driven timeline. Approval-gated: returns a composition plan for approval, generates assets, composes, runs a multimodal self-review loop, and delivers only when the result meets the bar.

plugins.name: izakaya-search
plugins.description: Search and recommend izakaya and restaurants based on party size, budget, and area. Aggregates reviews from Tabelog, Hot Pepper, and Google Maps with composite ratings and reservation links.

plugins.name: skill-packager
plugins.description: Package a skill directory into a distributable .skill archive placed on the Desktop. Zips ~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/ into ~/Desktop/<skill-name>.skill, ready for sharing or installation via Claude Desktop.
